gates.summary: policyengine 6.9.0, policyengine-uk 2.141.9 and policyengine-core 3.33.0 are installed and their requirements hold.
The pinned PyPI wheels match their RECORDs and the installed files (policyengine-uk: 2952 wheel members, 2952 installed files, policyengine-core: 199 wheel members, 199 installed files).
policyengine-core 3.33.0 satisfies policyengine-uk>=3.32.27; certification will record an exact qualified pair, since the publisher's claims do not cover both.
Read the release manifest and 7 artifacts with the configured credential; anonymous access returned HTTP 401.
enhanced_frs_2024_25 is the pinned 113,961,901 bytes with the UK single-year layout.
Supports 2024–2032, covering the required and horizon years.

11 model inputs are newly missing from the data (additional_residential_property_purchased, is_full_year_category_a_director, loss_relief, non_residential_property_purchased, non_residential_property_secured_debt, other_residential_property_secured_debt, pension_annual_allowance_taxable_lump_sum_death_benefits, pension_contributions_via_salary_sacrifice_pre_2015…)
Contract 2.1.0: every case, property and population check passed (905); 34 pending a methodology call; 120 unsupported by design.

model_only: checks newly warn: inert:war_widows_pension; the model's fiscal partition changed; metrics have no baseline: caseloads.war_widows_pension 2025, caseloads.war_widows_pension 2026, caseloads.war_widows_pension 2027, caseloads.war_widows_pension 2028, caseloads.war_widows_pension 2029, caseloads.war_widows_pension 2030, caseloads.war_widows_pension 2031, spending.war_widows_pension 2025; 153 metric move(s) exceed their review bounds; data_only: checks the previous pair ran were not run: sign:sda, sign:dfe_education_spending; 150 metric move(s) exceed their review bounds; 329 metric change(s) are withheld because a figure from fewer than 10 records is suppressed on one side, or the two sides leave out different ones and cannot be lined up
All 10 standard reforms ran and moved their targets by at least their minimums in every year from 2025-26 to 2031-32.
